scope.reason: This one fictional engagement includes Google Ads, Meta Ads and Klaviyo email only. Agency-wide service lists do not establish an individual client’s scope. SMS, Microsoft Advertising, Amazon Ads, Mailchimp and HubSpot are excluded from this scenario; no results are invented for them.

brief.business: Fictional US homeware retailer selling tableware and home essentials online.
goals: Improve first-order acquisition efficiency; scenario CPA review targets: non-brand Google Search ≤ $35 and Meta prospecting ≤ $35.
Improve email engagement and repeat-purchase relevance without assuming that attributed revenue is incremental.
Preserve brand voice and keep review, experimentation and implementation separate.
brief.voice: Warm, practical, calm US English. Product-specific benefits. Avoid urgency, invented discounts, unsupported sustainability claims and guaranteed outcomes.
constraints: No live campaign launch, budget adjustment or message send.
No changes to website, ad accounts, automations or reporting destinations.
Product facts, inventory, sender details and any claims require real client review.

reporting.note: Agency-supported destination verified publicly; the fictional client has no verified Client Hub account, URL or permissions. AURA displays a draft review only.

expertChecks: The fictional client, scope, goals and brand brief are not approved client evidence.
Google and Meta report different attribution windows and date bases; Klaviyo uses message-send cohorts. No cross-platform revenue or order total is valid here.
The latest conversion windows are still open. A single cutoff aligns extraction timing, not cohort maturity; re-extract only under a separately approved read-only review.
Weekly changes above the 20% review threshold are materially flagged, not statistically significant or causal findings.
Revenue is platform-attributed gross value with tax, shipping and refund treatment unconfirmed. Profit, customer acquisition cost and incrementality are not established.
Campaign audience mix changed; Meta repeated impressions and overlapping reach do not provide independent experimental sample sizes.
No live account, asset, tracking, reporting destination or consent has been verified for this fictional brand. A live execution remains blocked on approved inputs.
